raw_segments.text: They halted about the door of the mortuary chapel.
Mr. Bloom stood behind the boy with the wreath looking down at his sleek-combed hair and
at the slender furrowed neck inside his brand-new collar.
Poor boy, was he there when the father, both unconscious, lighten up at the last moment
and recognize for the last time all he might have done.
I owe three shillings to O'Grady.
The mutes bore the coffin into the chapel, which end is his head.
